text:
**Short answer:** Of the pages I could read, the **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charging Stand (Qi2 25W)** is the best pick for a desk stand that also travels.

I read Macworld's Satechi review in full. I couldn't read the Wired roundup. The page was too large to load, so none of this reflects Wired's testing.

## Top pick: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W Stand, $129.99
- **Charging:** 25W Qi2.2 for iPhone, 5W for the Apple Watch (fast-charge capable) and 5W for AirPods.
- **Stand design:** Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested. It holds the iPhone more than 70mm off the desk and tilts up to 160°, which suits FaceTime calls and keeping the screen visible.
- **In the box:** a 45W wall adapter with US, UK and EU plugs, plus a 4-foot cable.
- **Downsides:** It's bigger and heavier than the travel-focused rivals, at 399g versus 148g.
- **Buy:** [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GNRSY36V) · [Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/satechi-3-in-1-qi2-25w-fast-wireless-charging-stand-magnetic-foldable-for-iphone-apple-watch-airpods-space-black/J3GWC4C8TW) · [B&H](https://www.bhphotovideo.com/c/product/1960497-REG/satechi_st_q25f31c_ea_3_in_1_foldable_qi2_25w.html) · [Satechi](https://satechi.com/products/3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-with-qi2-25w)

## Alternatives
- **Kuxiu X40 Turbo, $79.99:** This is the most compact when folded (64 × 64 × 18.5mm). Macworld says it's the one to beat for travel, and it raises the phone about 35mm. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/2940617/kuxiu-x40-turbo-25w-wireless-charging-station-review.html) · [Kuxiu](https://kuxiu.co/products/kuxiu-x40-turbo-stand)
- **ESR CryoBoost Foldable 3-in-1 (25W), $99.99:** It's light (148g) and low-profile, lifting the phone only about 20mm. It's better for travel than for desk use. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FHQDKX7G)
  - A deal site (dealectric.com) lists code PARTNER18 as taking $17.99 off at ESR's store. I haven't verified it, so check it at checkout.
- **Ugreen 25W MagFlow 3-in-1 Folding:** This is a slim folding option, also lifting the phone about 20mm. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DZX533Y1)
- **Belkin UltraCharge Pro 3-in-1 and Anker Prime 3-in-1 MagGo:** Macworld calls both fast 25W stands. They're better as fixed desk chargers than for travel, and I didn't see prices for them. I also didn't see a review of the Ugreen MagFlow Pro 3-in-1 (with cooling fan), which Macworld published on Oct 13, 2026.

## How to choose
- **Desk first, occasional travel:** Satechi.
- **Mainly travel or a tight budget:** Kuxiu X40 Turbo.
- **Fixed desk setup only:** Look at the Belkin or Anker.

Make sure your charger is Qi2.2 certified if you want the full 25W. It only works with Qi2.2-capable iPhones, and older models charge more slowly.
